authority: read-only local database inspection; no chain access; no writes; no broadcast

method.anchorRule: replayed verbatim from closed_loop_anchor() in flashloan/rs-src/src/worker_pool.rs
method.bindingRule: replayed verbatim from anchor_binding_blocks_broadcast() in flashloan/rs-src/src/worker_pool.rs
method.conversionRule: only named conversion operations count as a conversion action; passing through the other anchor as an intermediate pool token does not
method.note: The kernel enforces the rule; this collector replays the same rule over the routes the system actually recorded and reports the readout.

crossAnchorActions.policy: ETH and WETH are two independent anchors; a request body carries no wrap/unwrap and no exchange between them

whatThisDoesNotProve: It does not prove profitability: every stored review is a real not-profitable outcome.
It does not prove depth, capacity or PnL.
It does not prove that a live broadcast happened: no transaction was sent.
It does not exercise the on-chain contract; it exercises the kernel's request-construction and anchor-binding rules.
It does not prove that a foreign-anchor request would have been rejected on-chain, only that the kernel refuses to build the batch.
